scopes.boundScope: Furthest checked carrier bound: at a=0,b=1 the complete initial conditioned-energy allowance is at most B*p^beta, -1/2<=beta<0. Every homogeneous and later-energy premise is discharged. The prime, actual padded quotient and p^S<=X cutoff conditions are explicit; constants and exponent are unevaluated. Full complex Riesz correlations, sampling costs and positive block normalization remain. Their combined source-scale saving is unproved. RH remains open.
scopes.sourceScope: Under the displayed hypothetical right-half-zero assumptions, the normalized original carrier has the prescribed negative-multiplicity source limit. This conditional source identity supplies one side of the proposed contradiction; its independent arithmetic counterpart remains open.
scopes.initialConditioningScope: The actual unweighted global Vinogradov moment has an unconditional exponent strictly below k(2u+1)-1/(3k), for every k>=2,u>=k and every sufficiently large endpoint. More generally, every proved admissible exponent above critical can be improved. All descendant energies, prime selection and actual quotient cutoffs are paid. Pointwise strict improvement does not prove convergence to critical; uniform improvement near the infimum, VK growth and the combined weighted saving remain open.
scopes.exponentAuditScope: Exact normalization audit: after restoring the source scale, lowering the exponent changes only the deep remainder by the coarse-quotient power. Every original intermediate conditioned energy is identical. The complete scaled allowance is no larger when a full coarse window fits. This comparison bounds no intermediate energy and does not prove RH.
scopes.fullRecurrenceScope: The general original-carrier recurrence applies to every displayed finite scale pair a<=b and depth H. Both actual quotient moments use the proved exponent k(2u+1)-1/(3k); every intermediate energy remains in the full allowance. The default view additionally bounds the complete initial allowance by a negative profile under its deeper cutoff conditions. No net signed correlation saving or RH contradiction is asserted.
